prompt: clear disappointment. You nearly finish placing an object neatly, but it slips and ruins the attempt.
idea: An intent finishing reach jolts upward at the slip, then collapses into a low, folded posture with the gaze fixed on the failed placement.

prompt: slipped, visibly deflated
idea: The arm folds sharply downward, then the whole body withdraws a little and turns away with its gaze lowered.

prompt: Let your posture sink when the object slips just before you finish placing it.
idea: The gripper closes a moment too late, and the arm sinks while still reaching toward the object before the body slowly pulls back.

prompt: Hold a disappointed slump after the nearly successful placement fails.
idea: The nearly completed reach collapses into a deep folded slump that lingers with a lowered gaze and only a faint breathing motion.

prompt: owning a mistake. You realise the answer you just confidently gave someone was wrong.
idea: Its confident height abruptly collapses, then it leans back toward the person with a sober nod and a humbled posture.

prompt: my mistake, plainly apologetic
idea: It closes its mouth, gathers slightly upward, and makes one square, unembellished bow before meeting the person's gaze.

prompt: Clearly acknowledge your wrong answer with a sincere apology.
idea: It withdraws briefly, folds low toward the person, and gives two measured acknowledgements before looking up with its arm still tucked.

prompt: Admit you got the answer wrong with an unmistakably apologetic posture.
idea: It sharply abandons its raised posture, looks directly at the person from a closed stance, and deliberately bows even lower.

prompt: cheerful completion. You finish the household chore and announce that everything is done.
idea: MARS turns from the chore toward the person, springs into an open announcement, and punctuates it with two cheerful bounces.

prompt: all finished, pleased lift
idea: A buoyant lift opens MARS's posture, with two light mouth beats announcing completion before it rests comfortably tall.

prompt: Lift your posture cheerfully to mark the completed chore.
idea: MARS dips and draws back, lifts brightly toward the person, then seals the finished chore with one deliberate nod.

prompt: job complete, bright satisfaction
idea: MARS gives the finished work a brief surveying turn, then faces forward with a bright open lift and a lingering satisfied sway.

prompt: warm recognition. You spot a friend arriving at your doorway.
idea: MARS gathers slightly, turns toward the doorway, and opens into a raised greeting with two warm arm waves.

prompt: friend spotted, visibly brightening
idea: MARS catches sight of its friend, springs visibly taller and wider, and rolls a little closer with two buoyant bobs.

prompt: Brighten and turn toward your friend as they enter the doorway.
idea: MARS turns fully toward its friend, spreads its arm in welcome, and gives two eager nods before settling into a warm forward lean.

prompt: Give your arriving friend a clear, warm turn of attention.
idea: MARS squares its base toward its friend, opens and rises with one deliberate nod, then edges forward into attentive stillness.

prompt: cut off mid-sentence. You are halfway through an explanation when someone begins speaking over you.
idea: The animated mouth clamps shut as the arm retracts with a startled hitch, followed by a deliberate turn into attentive listening.

prompt: sentence cut short, politely yielding
idea: The forward speaking lean breaks off, the mouth closes, and a small backward roll gives the speaker room while the gaze stays attentive.

prompt: Break off mid-sentence and settle into a clear, attentive pause.
idea: The mouth closes with the arm briefly suspended mid-gesture, then the arm lowers and a single nod marks the handover.

prompt: unfinished sentence, listening now
idea: The mouth hangs briefly half open on the unfinished word, then closes as the robot turns and leans toward the new speaker.

prompt: deliberate comparison. You are weighing whether to finish a chore now or save it for later.
idea: The base turns thoughtfully toward each possibility while the arm shifts from reserved to engaged, then centers between them.

prompt: thoughtful, weighing the options
idea: An upward gaze and tucked arm accompany two slow forward-and-back rocks before the body rests in consideration.

prompt: Make your deliberation clear as you consider when to tackle the chore.
idea: The body briefly opens and leans toward doing the chore now, then withdraws into an upward-looking consideration of later.

prompt: Hold a visibly thoughtful posture while considering the advantages of each chore schedule.
idea: The arm stays tucked and visibly canted while an upward, sideways-facing gaze pauses over each possibility with small changes of lean.

prompt: friendly farewell. You wave goodbye as a friend leaves your doorway and promises to visit again.
idea: MARS nods at the promise, lifts into a welcoming wave, and finishes with an expectant upward gaze.

prompt: see you later, friendly wave
idea: MARS gives a breezy pair of waves, pauses, and adds a smaller last wave before relaxing.

prompt: Wave your friend off warmly at the door.
idea: MARS rolls a little closer to the doorway, waves with an open raised arm, and leans after its friend before settling.

prompt: Say see you soon with an easy, friendly wave.
idea: MARS gives an unhurried open wave, then leans in with a small affirmative nod as if confirming the next visit.

prompt: warm attentive listening. You hear a friend explain why their day has been difficult.
idea: MARS opens its posture, leans warmly toward its friend, and carries a slow gentle sway through its attention.

prompt: I'm listening, gentle forward lean
idea: MARS eases forward in two stages, holds the offered attention, and relaxes only slightly while keeping its gaze lifted.

prompt: Lean gently forward and listen as a friend describes a difficult day.
idea: MARS inclines toward its friend with an open posture, acknowledges a difficult moment with a slow nod, and resumes listening.

prompt: Hold a warm, patient listening posture through the silence between their words.
idea: MARS keeps its warm forward posture through the silence, allowing only a tiny slow rise and fall before settling again.

prompt: missing a whole phrase. You cannot catch the middle of a sentence over clattering dishes.
idea: The clatter causes a brief recoil and sideways glance before the base faces the speaker and the whole body reaches forward to listen.

prompt: sorry, repeat that phrase
idea: A brief apologetic dip opens into a clear listening lean, followed by one gentle nod inviting the phrase again.

prompt: Lean forward with clear listening interest and request the missed phrase again.
idea: The arm opens as the body leans forward, then a small roll closer and an inviting nod make the request clear.

prompt: trying harder to hear you
idea: The body tests one listening angle, briefly eases back, then tries the other side with a deeper lean and a closer stance.

prompt: warm homecoming wave. You greet a friend coming home after a day away.
idea: MARS gathers back, rolls a little closer into two broad welcoming waves, and stays softly raised and attentive.

prompt: hello again, cheerful wave
idea: MARS spots its friend to one side, lifts high for three brisk waves, and punctuates the greeting with a cheerful nod.

prompt: Give your friend a clear, cheerful wave as they arrive home.
idea: MARS turns toward its friend, springs into three clear arm waves, and opens into a lingering forward welcome.

prompt: Raise your arm for a warm welcome-back wave.
idea: MARS raises its arm for a gentle wave, lifts it a little higher for a warmer second sweep, and settles with an inviting lean.

prompt: skeptical disagreement. You hear that one successful trial proves a plan always works, and you disagree.
idea: A tiny nod acknowledges the successful trial, then MARS draws back and shakes its base twice at the sweeping conclusion.

prompt: skeptical, definite no
idea: MARS snaps out of its curious cant, clamps its mouth, and delivers two crisp no swings followed by a pointed pause.

prompt: Clearly disagree with treating one success as proof.
idea: MARS weighs the result with an aside glance, turns squarely back, and rejects the conclusion with three measured base shakes and a closed posture.

prompt: Make your skeptical disagreement plainly apparent.
idea: An inquisitive cant straightens as MARS draws back, gives two measured no swings, and adds one sharper refusal with a small backward step.

prompt: politely refusing. You are offered a second cup of tea and definitely do not want any.
idea: MARS acknowledges the cup with a glance, then pulls its arm close and gives a measured no followed by one confirming shake.

prompt: no thank you, clear
idea: MARS squares up, draws back with its mouth closed, and delivers two broad, even no beats before settling upright.

prompt: make your refusal of another cup clear and polite.
idea: MARS takes a small step back and repeats a clear no after a listening pause, keeping its gaze lifted throughout.

prompt: Make it unmistakable that you are declining the offer.
idea: MARS visibly withdraws from the offer, gives a sustained broad no, and stays squarely pulled back after the motion stops.

prompt: deliberate patience. You hold your response while someone carefully finishes their explanation.
idea: MARS starts to answer, deliberately closes its mouth, and gives a small acknowledging nod before holding its attention on the speaker.

prompt: attentive, patiently holding your turn
idea: MARS turns slightly toward the speaker and holds a poised, closed-mouth posture with a tiny warm sway.

prompt: settle into an attentive pause until the speaker finishes.
idea: MARS lets its raised, ready posture settle into a comfortable stance while keeping its gaze and lean directed toward the speaker.

prompt: keep a softly attentive posture while you wait for the reply.
idea: MARS holds a low, softly open arm with its gaze lifted, letting a tiny forward-and-back lean carry its quiet attention.

prompt: warm approval. You and your friend settle on a movie you have wanted to watch.
idea: A small inward gather opens into a warm forward lean, a pleased mouth, and one generous nod.

prompt: pleased agreement, clear nod
idea: An upright, lightly open posture delivers two clear nods and settles with an attentive forward lean.

prompt: Agree warmly with the movie choice.
idea: A brief sideways glance returns to the friend with an open posture and two nods, the second softer than the first.

prompt: Absolutely, that sounds wonderful.
idea: A brief folded gather bursts into a broad open welcome, two enthusiastic nods, and a pleased sideways sway.
